source.author: ov
source.text: Inde fide maius glaebae coepere moveri, primaque de sulcis acies apparuit hastae, tegmina mox capitum picto nutantia cono, mox umeri pectusque onerataque bracchia telis exsistunt, crescitque seges clipeata virorum.
source.text_original: Inde (fide maius) glaebae coepere moveri, / primaque de sulcis acies apparuit hastae, / tegmina mox capitum picto nutantia cono, / mox umeri pectusque onerataque bracchia telis / exsistunt, crescitque seges clipeata virorum.
source.text_english: Then, with faith, a greater marvel began: clods of earth were stirred, and from the furrows first appeared the line of spears, then the helmet-crests swaying on their painted cones, then shoulders and chests and arms burdened with weapons emerged, and the crop of shield-bearing men grew.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tollunt se galeae sulcisque ex omnibus hastae et iam iamque umeri.
reuse.text_original: tollunt se galeae sulcisque ex omnibus hastae / et iam iamque umeri.
reuse.text_english: Helmets rise up, and spears from every furrow, and now, now shoulders too.
